title: Actual scheme ordinary evaluation component
statement: For a scheme Y and integer complexes P,F of module sheaves, and p+q=n, construct the morphism from F^p tensor Hom(P,O[0])^q to Hom(P^r,F^(r+n)) by the tensor-Hom formula of [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-formula]. It is zero when r+q is nonzero and otherwise curries scalar evaluation, including the degree equality isomorphism.
